year-round-business-tax-planning/index.h.description: Use a quarterly business tax planning checklist, then review AE Tax Advisors’ advisory scope, implementation responsibilities and engagement fees.
year-round-business-tax-planning/index.h.heading: Need help implementing your quarterly plan?
year-round-business-tax-planning/index.h.body:
A checklist organizes the decisions; an advisory engagement defines who models the options, completes the work and coordinates with your return preparer. Start with business tax planning services, compare advisory fees and return-preparation scope, and review published client case studies in context.

Bring current financials, owner compensation, your entity list and the next decision deadline. Confirm deliverables and responsibilities in the written engagement.

Discuss My Business Tax Plan

blog/tax-planning-timeline-before-sellin.heading: Planning an exit or planning throughout the year?
blog/tax-planning-timeline-before-sellin.body: A sale creates transaction-specific deadlines. If you need ongoing planning before a sale is on the calendar, use the quarterly business tax planning checklist and review business-owner tax advisory services. Keep sale advice tied to your transaction documents and decision dates.

cost-segregation-study-cost-pricing/inde.heading: Move from a published rate to a property-specific scope
cost-segregation-study-cost-pricing/inde.body:
Compare the study fee and quote-scope guide with the work your property needs. Bring square footage, purchase and placed-in-service dates, closing records and existing depreciation schedules. Ask the team to identify study work, return implementation and any separately priced work in the written quote.

Discuss Your Property and Study Quote

cost-segregation-study-cost-pricing/inde.description: AE Tax Advisors study pricing: $1 per square foot, $2,000 minimum. Compare report scope, preparer handoff and separately priced implementation work.

cost-segregation-airbnb/index.html.description: Review an Airbnb cost segregation study, required property records, report scope, preparer coordination and published fees with AE Tax Advisors.
cost-segregation-airbnb/index.html.heading: Prepare for an Airbnb study review
cost-segregation-airbnb/index.html.body:
Bring closing records, a supported land allocation, improvement invoices, the placed-in-service date and any prior depreciation schedules. Discuss the report deliverables, who will implement the study on the return, and what support is included in your quote.

Start with the Airbnb and short-term-rental study guide, review study pricing and scope, and coordinate the broader STR tax strategy with your tax adviser.
